# Sundered Isles Assets

Every asset card for a Sundered Isles campaign: the Sundered Isles cards, one file per category
under `rules/assets/sundered-isles/`, and the Starforged cards, which still apply, under `rules/assets/`
(from the starforged adapter). On each card, `[x]` marks an ability you start with and
`[ ]` one you unlock with experience (Advance, `rules/moves.md`).

## Command Vehicle Assets

- Sundered Isles (`rules/assets/sundered-isles/command-vehicle.md`): Flagship.
- Starforged (`rules/assets/command-vehicle.md`): Starship.

## Companion Assets

- Sundered Isles (`rules/assets/sundered-isles/companion.md`): Albatross, Chattering Skull, Dolphin, Dragon, Jungle Cat, Monkey, Parrot, Rat, The Kraken.
- Starforged (`rules/assets/companion.md`): Banshee, Combat Bot, Glowcat, Protocol Bot, Rockhorn, Sidekick, Sprite, Survey Bot, Symbiote, Utility Bot, Voidglider.

## Deed Assets

- Sundered Isles (`rules/assets/sundered-isles/deed.md`): Cohort, Damned, Fleet Commander, Old Salt, Undead.
- Starforged (`rules/assets/deed.md`): Bonded, Homesteader, Marked, Oathbreaker, Revenant, Survivor, Vanguard.
